checks: Reproduced baseline: all three skin status labels overlap.
New save: independent labels, complete previews, classic selected, silver/gold locked.
Short pointer charge: current-platform landing preserves score.
Long keyboard charge: miss returns to takeoff with unchanged score.
Six manual consecutive successful jumps: real scoring and saved best, no automatic jump or centering.
Miss after consecutive jumps returns to nonzero takeoff position and resets center combo.
Menu freezes scene time; restart resets this run and keeps mode.
Normal mode: overshoot still reaches the real game-over screen.
Normal mode preference survives page reload.
Opening menu during pointer charge cancels it; late release cannot jump.
Seven skin switches: preview/selection/material maps correspond; gold survives start, restart and reload; legacy best/records retained.
Skin panel fits 320x568, 736x414 landscape and 1440x900; every card remains fully reachable through scrolling.
Mobile touch emulation: long touch overshoots and safely retries.
No page errors or remote runtime requests.
